_comment: INDUSTRIAL: a radiator fin bank on a dark mounting frame. The tallest thing the kit puts on flat panel, and the piece that says the hull is a machine with heat to get rid of. The fins are deliberately over half as tall as the piece is wide - a shallow fin bank photographs as a grille, and the read that is wanted is a THING standing on the hull. Fins run along +Z so `align: Run` combs them the same way down a panel.
